title: ContainersPost
description:
ContainersPost represents the fields required to launch a new container for
a specific application

addons.description: Addons to enable for the container

app_id.description: ID of the application to use. Can be empty if an image ID is specified instead

app_version.description: Version of the application to use. If not specified, the latest version is used.

boot_activity.description: BootActivity specifies the Android activity which is started by default

boot_package.description: BootPackage specifies the Android application package name which is started by default

devmode.description: DevMode specifies if development mode has been turned on for the container

disable_watchdog.description: DisableWatchdog defines whether the watchdog is disabled

features.description: Feature flags to enable for the container.

metrics_server.description: MetricsServer specifies a metrics server the container will use

platform.description: Platform specifies the Anbox platform the container is running with

cpus.description: Number of CPU cores the container should get assigned.

disk_size.description: Disk size the container should get allocated in bytes

gpu-slots.description: Number of GPU slots the container should get assigned.

image_id.description: ID of the image to use. Can be empty if an application ID is specified instead.

image_version.description: Version of the image to use. If not specified, the latest version is used.

instance_type.description:
Instance type to use for the container.
Example a2.3

memory.description: Memory the container should get assigned in bytes.

no_start.description: Do not start the container after creation.

node.description: Node to start the container on. If empty node will be automatically selected.

services.description: Services to enable for the container

tags.description: Tags which will be assigned to the container

user_data.description: User data to pass to the container.

vpu-slots.description: Number of VPU slots the container should get assigned

NetworkProtocol.description: NetworkProtocol describes a specific network protocol like TCP or UDP a ContainerService can use

NetworkServiceSpec.description: NetworkServiceSpec is used to define the user defined network services that should be opened on a container

expose.description:
Expose defines wether the service is exposed on the public endpoint of the node
or if it is only available on the private endpoint. To expose the service set to
true and to false otherwise.

name.description:
Name gives the container a hint what the exposed port is being used for. This
allows further tweaks inside the container to expose the service correctly.
Exampe: ssh

port.description: Port is the port the container provides a service on

port_end.description:
PortEnd is the end of the port range set for a service. If empty, only a
single port is opened

protocols.description: List of network protocols (tcp, udp) the port should be exposed for
